subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word to fill in the blank.

The curving rod offers the _______ (mirage) of a larger and spacious bathtub.
solution:
The correct answer is **option(3)** i.e. '__**Illusion'.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mirage**: (मरीचिका) An optical phenomenon where distant objects appear to be reflected or distorted, often due to atmospheric conditions.

 
 
• **Example: **The desert's heat created a **mirage**, making it seem as though there was a lake on the horizon.
 
 
 
• **Illusion:** (मिथ्या भ्रांति) A false or misleading perception or belief; something that appears real but is not.
 
 
• **Example: **The magician created the **illusion **of a rabbit appearing out of an empty hat.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **'illusion'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word Reflexes (प्रतिक्रिया) means an action performed in response to a stimulus without conscious thought.

 
 
• **Example:** When the doctor tapped the patient's knee with a rubber hammer, their **reflexes **caused their leg to kick out.
 
 
 
• The word Fission (विभाजन) means the process of splitting the nucleus of an atom into smaller parts.
 
 
• **Example:** Nuclear power plants use controlled **fission **reactions to generate electricity.
 
 
 
• The word Virtual (आभासी) means not physically existing but made to appear to be so by software.
 
 
• **Example: **In the **virtual **world of the video game, players can explore imaginary landscapes and complete quests.
